last.verdict: Shares slipped as lower sales guidance outweighed record-margin profit and a new buyback.

reasons.label: Sales outlook cut
reasons.text: 2026 sales forecast lowered to $4.6B–$4.9B from $4.9B–$5.2B; fewer modules expected to ship.

reasons.label: Sales fell 23%
reasons.text: Quarterly sales dropped to $1.23B as fewer modules were sold to outside customers.

reasons.label: Profit and buyback cushion
reasons.text: Earnings rose 25% to $5.30 a share; board approved a $500M share buyback.

story: Profit has stayed strong, with margins near 60%, but sales are shrinking: down 4% last quarter, then down 23% this one. Management cut its 2026 sales forecast after holding it in July. Shares rose 2.4% last time, then slipped this time.

history.verdict: Big profit beat and steady outlook outweighed a small sales dip; shares edged up.

reasons.label: Profit well above forecasts
reasons.text: Earnings of $3.92 a share beat analyst estimates of roughly $2.74–$2.89.

reasons.label: Much fatter margins
reasons.text: Adjusted EBITDA margin hit 61% versus 51% a year ago, as costs fell.

reasons.label: Guidance held, sales dipped
reasons.text: Full-year targets were reaffirmed; sales fell 4% to $1.06B on terminated customer contracts.
